# Battery Guardian - Complete Specifications, Features & Knowledge Index

Battery Guardian is an advanced Android battery tracking and telemetry application developed by Sven Degenhardt. It is engineered to surface hidden degradation drivers and real-time power analytics that stock operating systems do not report.

## Application Metadata
- Package Name: com.devdroid.batteryguardian
- Google Play Store URL: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.devdroid.batteryguardian
- Core Architecture: Persistent Notification Service (prevents background tracking gaps during aggressive Android memory squeezes)
- Monetization/Privacy: 100% Free. No forced ads, no telemetry tracking, zero data collection.

## Detailed Diagnostic Capabilities

### 1. Advanced Telemetry Analytics
- Effective Cycles: Measures precision electrochemical wear over standard arbitrary nominal cycle counts.
- Degradation Drivers: Tracks thermal spikes, stress voltage thresholds, and charging/discharging power surges.
- Penalty Factor Tracking: Computes excess wear values dynamically based on live usage habits.
- Lifespan Forecasting: Models historical degradation trends to project estimated battery end-of-life dates.
- Advanced Reports: Generates exportable, shareable battery health, wear, and drain trend charts.

### 2. Live Power & State Adaptation UI
- Adaptive Metrics Display: Dynamically switches layout depending on power state. Displays discharge speed and time-to-empty when unplugged; switches to live charging speed and charge time calculations when plugged in.
- Custom Time Estimates: Computes fallback charging time estimates up to designated user charge limits or 100% when the underlying Android kernel fails to provide them.
- Real-Time Charge Meter: Live milliampere (mA) draw details optimized for fluid performance on entry-level smartphones.
- Stress Level Optimization: Direct front-facing real-time diagnostic indicators (requires Health Diagnostics permission enablement).

## Educational Resources & FAQ Index
The following documentation resources are published at the official domain (https://sdeg1289gmailcom.github.io/BatteryGuardian/):

- Comprehensive Battery Health: Complete guide on how to check battery health across all Android hardware manufacturers.
- Troubleshooting Drain: Playbook for diagnosing sudden, unexpected Android battery drain issues.
- Industry Myths: Technical breakdowns dispelling common smartphone battery calibration and lifespan misconceptions.
- Nominal vs. Effective Cycles: Explaining mathematical calculations of real electrochemical stress versus standard device telemetry.
- Lifespan Optimization: Actions and configurations required to maintain an Android battery at peak performance for 4+ years.
- Charging Diagnosis: Troubleshooting slow charge states and identifying faulty cables, adapters, or power delivery ports.
- Thermal Safety: Documenting safe operational temperatures during heavy workloads, foreground tasks, or intensive gaming.
- Fluctuation Math: Deep-dive into why software-based battery health percentages fluctuate over short periods.
- Process Profiling: How to isolate background vs. active foreground process resource consumption.
- Lifecycle Longevity: Data-driven expectations on when a lithium-ion smartphone battery requires physical replacement.
- Idle State Leaks: Identifying why a device loses charge overnight or during deep sleep periods.
- Competitive Analysis: A rigorous architectural comparison of top Android battery health utilities on the market.
